c74object.name: evi_biquads
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_biquads.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_biquads.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_biquads.genexpr file also requires:
evi_biquads_union.genexpr
evi_biquads_filters.genexpr
evi_biquads_extras.genexpr
About this File:
This file requires all evieve Biquads code in one require. You will rarely need this catch-all and should look into the individual requires contained here as it is more efficient to include subsets of GenExpr code. There are more filter types when you use Biquads (40 different types in evieve) but Biquads are inferior filters to TPT SVF filters, so you might wish to use the evieve SVFs instead in most situations.
